Level Yaletown – Seymour
Yaletown - Seymour
Vancouver’s trendy Yaletown is filled with some of the city’s best boutique shopping, eateries, nightlife, and minutes from world-class beaches and outdoor adventure. Stay close to it all at Level Yaletown – Seymour.

Available for nightly and extended stays, enjoy spacious suites and townhome-style accommodations boasting fully-equipped kitchens, 24 hour Guest Services and access to over 11,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor lifestyle amenities.

Bypass nightly hotel stays and subpar short-term housing that cramps your style. Whether you’re here for business, leisure, or a little of both, Level offers the comforts of home combined with the luxuries of a boutique hotel. Spend the day exploring the city and end it relaxing by the pool. Take the afternoon to learn to explore the farmer’s market and the evening to make a meal for friends in your suite’s fully-equipped kitchen. Or finish a day of meetings and toast to happy hour on the terrace. Welcome to the suite life at Level Yaletown – Seymour.

Vancouver destination intro
The Suite Way to Stay in Vancouver
Vancouver blends vibrant city life with breathtaking natural beauty. Discover award-winning restaurants, local boutiques, craft breweries, and iconic attractions like Stanley Park, Granville Island, and the Yaletown Seawall—all set against the North Shore mountains and Pacific coastline.
With three downtown Vancouver locations and suites in nearby Richmond, Level Vancouver offers apartment-style accommodations for hotel stays, short-term furnished suites to settle in, and extended stays designed for comfort, flexibility, and modern city living.

Properties intro
The Suite Way To Escape.
Maybe it’s the top-tier restaurants, local boutiques or nightlife, or maybe it’s the stunning sunsets, expansive coastline or North Shore mountains. Whether you love vibrant urban centers or restorative natural spaces, Vancouver delivers.
If you want to see Vancouver like a local, put on your walking shoes. A city with a surprisingly small footprint, it’s the sort of place best experienced on a leisurely stroll, where you can explore unique local shops, quench your thirst at one of our craft breweries, or grab a snack from the legendary food trucks. With three downtown Vancouver locations, Level guests can take advantage of their proximity to some of the city’s coolest neighbourhoods. Travelers seeking more tranquil surroundings can experience Level accommodations and flexible lease apartments in Richmond or Port Moody, located in greater Vancouver.
Whether you’re in need of short-term accommodations, monthly studio rental, or are a family seeking extra space while on vacation, Level Hotels & Furnished Suites offer exceptional value. Travelers visiting for business or pleasure can experience the convenient services, thoughtful design, and amenities that add ease and function to day-to-day life. Stay in the heart of downtown Vancouver or nearby Richmond or Port Moody, located in metro Vancouver.

Staying a Month or Longer?
From fully equipped kitchens and in-suite laundry to spacious layouts and pet-friendly accommodations, Level makes longer stays feel effortless—whether you’re relocating, traveling for work, or simply staying awhile in Vancouver.

Suites
Experience the suite life in downtown Vancouver’s Level at Yaletown. Enjoy fully-equipped kitchens with premium appliances—cookery and dishware included—spacious living areas, personal outdoor balconies or patios, private bedrooms and convenient in-suite laundry washer and dryer. Modern in style, personal in space, our thoughtfully designed suites, 24/7 Guest Services, and unmatched amenities let you do you with style.
Whether staying a few nights or a few months, with options for nightly accommodations and flexible lease apartments ranging from monthly studio rental to two bedroom townhomes, living the Level difference is well within reach.

Suites page
Modern suites in Vancouver’s most vibrant neighborhood
In the heart of Yaletown’s dining, shopping, and nightlife scene, Level Yaletown Seymour offers studio, one- and two-bedroom suites, plus two-level townhomes, available for nightly hotel stays and extended stays. Settle into stylish city living with fully equipped kitchens, lounge-worthy living space, in-suite laundry, and private balconies in select layouts—designed to let you experience Vancouver your way.

Stays that feel closer to home.

Ideal for nightly stays, solo travelers, or extended visits that feel light and effortless.
Whether you’re heading out for late-night bites in Yaletown or easing into a slower morning with coffee on the balcony, this suite makes Vancouver feel easy.

The Penthouse at Seymour — 3 Bedrooms | 8,425 sqft (official pages)
Spanning 8,425 square feet, the Penthouse at Seymour crowns the building with expansive indoor–outdoor living, a rooftop pool, and sweeping city and mountain views. Designed for hosting, celebrating, or simply indulging, it’s one of Vancouver’s most exceptional luxury penthouse stays.
Discover the next level of luxury with The Penthouse at Level Seymour in Vancouver’s trendy Yaletown neighborhood. A sprawling 8,425 sqft of exceptional living space, The Penthouse exudes sophistication featuring 3 bedrooms, catering kitchen, and rooftop pool and entertainment space boasting stunning city and mountain views.

The Penthouse at Level Seymour -Vancouver-
A Lavish Retreat in Vancouver
Rising above Vancouver’s vibrant Yaletown, The Penthouse at Level Seymour offers 8,425 sq ft of refined indoor–outdoor living designed for those who want space, privacy, and unforgettable views. With three bedrooms, a gourmet kitchen and catering kitchen, and a private rooftop pool and entertainment terrace, this is a penthouse stay that balances sophistication with effortless livability.

Thoughtfully Designed Living
Natural stone, warm wood tones, and contemporary glass accents set the tone throughout the penthouse. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with light while framing sweeping city and mountain views, creating a home that feels both expansive and intimate. Custom furnishings, statement lighting, and carefully curated details elevate every room without overwhelming it.

Your Private Rooftop Oasis
This is where the city fades away. A private rooftop pool, generous lounge areas, and multiple outdoor gathering spaces invite everything from slow mornings to late-night conversations beneath the skyline. Inside, the primary bedroom features a gas marble fireplace and a spa-inspired ensuite, offering a quiet retreat after days spent in the city.

Designed for Entertaining
From intimate dinners to full-scale celebrations, The Penthouse is made for hosting. A chef-level kitchen paired with a catering kitchen, formal dining space, indoor bar, and 4,000 sq ft of outdoor entertainment space make it sought after for private events, milestone celebrations, or elevated stays meant to be shared. Every space flows naturally, indoors to out.

Penthouse Living, Level Service
Guests enjoy full access to Level’s lifestyle amenities and attentive guest services throughout their stay, including housekeeping, secure parking, and fitness and wellness spaces just steps away. Whether you’re hosting, unwinding, or staying awhile, the Penthouse delivers the privacy of a residence with the ease of a serviced stay.

Transition seamlessly from a high-energy workday to a relaxed evening with friends. Start with an invigorating workout, followed by a quick sauna session and a dip in the heated pool. Resort-inspired spaces, built for city living
At Level Yaletown Seymour, amenities are designed to match the pace of the neighborhood—social, flexible, and effortlessly cool. With 11,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor spaces, it’s easy to shift from work mode to downtime without leaving home.
Start the day with a workout or sauna session. Take a midday break by the outdoor pool and hot tub. End the evening hosting friends on the rooftop terrace, BBQ fired up, with city lights as your backdrop.
Back in your suite, enjoy fully equipped kitchens, in-suite laundry, high-speed Wi-Fi, premium linens and robes, and private balconies—plus housekeeping and pet-friendly accommodations that make both short visits and extended stays feel seamless.

Stay a Night. Stay a While.
Level Yaletown – Seymour is one of the few downtown Vancouver properties offering both nightly hotel stays and extended stays. Stay a few nights to experience Yaletown’s dining, nightlife, and waterfront walks, then linger longer with apartment-style suites featuring fully equipped kitchens, in-suite laundry, and access to 11,000 sq ft of lifestyle amenities—all in the heart of the city.

Extended Stays in Downtown Vancouver
Designed for 30+ night stays, Seymour makes long-term living in Vancouver feel easy. Spacious suites with full kitchens, private outdoor spaces, and in-suite laundry, paired with resort-style amenities and a walkable Yaletown location, create a home base that works for relocations, work projects, and longer chapters in the city.

Eat, Drink, and Explore Yaletown
From late-night ramen and craft cocktails to waterfront walks and morning coffee runs, Yaletown is one of Vancouver’s most walkable—and livable—neighborhoods. Stay steps from the action, then retreat to space, comfort, and calm when you’re ready to slow things down. We’re here to show you the suite way to do Yaletown.

Neighborhood
Located in the heart of Vancouver, Level Yaletown – Seymour has top-notch restaurants, fantastic shopping—ranging from avant garde to high-end to handmade. The exquisite natural beauty is unmatched, and the ways to enjoy it are many: gondola lift rides, water taxis, kayaking, white water rafting, hiking, and more.
Beyond month-to-month rent apartments and nightly stays, with Level you gain access to knowledge from people proud to call Vancouver home. From how to get to and traverse through colossal Stanley Park to where to dine on the best vegan meats to the choicest steak, get the lowdown of where to go and what to do from Level Vancouverites in the know.

Travel Guide intro
Eat, Drink and Explore Vancouver
Nestled between the Pacific Ocean and the Coast Mountains, Vancouver boasts a breathtaking backdrop of snow-capped peaks, lush forests, and picturesque waterways. The city’s cosmopolitan atmosphere is enriched by its diverse population, with vibrant neighborhoods like Gastown, Chinatown, and Granville Island offering a blend of historic charm and contemporary flair. Vancouver is renowned for its outdoor recreational opportunities, including hiking in Stanley Park, skiing in nearby Whistler, and exploring the scenic landscapes of the North Shore. With a thriving arts and culinary scene (with arguably the best seafood in the world), world-class museums and galleries, and a commitment to sustainability, Vancouver offers a vibrant and inclusive urban experience amidst its stunning natural surroundings. To inspire your time in Vancouver, we’ve put together a highlight of some of our favorite spots.

Vancouver City Guide (properties)
Experience the city the way locals do. From coastal walks and pet-friendly parks to brunch favorites and adventure-filled day trips. Level’s curated Travel Guide to Vancouver’s neighborhoods, food scene, and outdoor escapes will lead the way.

Frequently Asked Questions
1. What are your check-in and check-out times?
Early check-in or late check-out requests are based upon availability and may incur additional charges. Please inquire directly with the property you are staying at for check-in/out requests.
Level Vancouver – Yaletown Seymour Check-in: 4 pm Check-out: 10 am
Arrival Information
Level Yaletown – Seymour has an entrance on Seymour Street and in the alley between Nelson and Helmcken Streets
Please use the intercom (buzz 100) to access the main door of the building and check in with Guest Services
You will be required to sign the Terms and Conditions and provide a credit card for any personal incidentals during your stay.
Minimum Check-in Age: 21
Individuals under the age of 21 are not allowed to check in or occupy a room unless they are accompanied by an adult, whether it be a parent or guardian.

2. What is the minimum length of stay?
Due to 2024 legislation changes within BC, some of our properties have a minimum length of stay of 90 days. We have 4 properties and stays under 90 nights may be redirected to a different property.

3. What can I expect in my suite?
Fully-equipped kitchen with appliances, pots, pans, dishes, utensils and cutlery
In-suite washer/dryer and ironing set
Smart TVs
Wireless internet, local calling and voicemail
Heating and air conditioning
Premium furnishings and linens
Access to our lifestyle amenities and dedicated concierge services
Stays of 6 or more nights receive complimentary bi-weekly housekeeping

4. What is my reservation cancellation policy?
For nightly stays, reservations must be cancelled or modified 24 hours before a scheduled arrival date, or guests will be charged one night room and tax.
For extended stays, guests may be liable to pay cancelation charges of up to 100% of the negotiated rent for the balance of the term of the Accommodation Agreement. Please note that a change in the length or dates of your reservation may result in a rate change.

Vancouver blends vibrant city life with breathtaking natural beauty. Discover award-winning restaurants, local boutiques, craft breweries, and iconic attractions like Stanley Park, Granville Island, and the Yaletown Seawall—all set against the North Shore mountains and Pacific coastline.
With three downtown Vancouver locations and suites in nearby Richmond, Level Vancouver offers apartment-style accommodations for hotel stays, short-term furnished suites to settle in, and extended stays designed for comfort, flexibility, and modern city living.

Maybe it’s the top-tier restaurants, local boutiques or nightlife, or maybe it’s the stunning sunsets, expansive coastline or North Shore mountains. Whether you love vibrant urban centers or restorative natural spaces, Vancouver delivers.
If you want to see Vancouver like a local, put on your walking shoes. A city with a surprisingly small footprint, it’s the sort of place best experienced on a leisurely stroll, where you can explore unique local shops, quench your thirst at one of our craft breweries, or grab a snack from the legendary food trucks. With three downtown Vancouver locations, Level guests can take advantage of their proximity to some of the city’s coolest neighbourhoods. Whether you’re in need of short-term accommodations, monthly studio rental, or are a family seeking extra space while on vacation, Level Hotels & Furnished Suites offer exceptional value. Eat, Drink and Explore Vancouver

Vancouver is renowned for its outdoor recreational opportunities, including hiking in Stanley Park, skiing in nearby Whistler, and exploring the scenic landscapes of the North Shore. With a thriving arts and culinary scene (with arguably the best seafood in the world), world-class museums and galleries, and a commitment to sustainability, Vancouver offers a vibrant and inclusive urban experience amidst its stunning natural surroundings.
